MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable Samsung T7 feels useful alongside my older desktop external drive because it adds convenient file transfers without requiring an internal installation.",
    "The Blink bundle builds on my earlier home-security interest and works with the Alexa devices I already have, giving them a new use.",
    "The HDMI switch connects two things I already use—Blu-ray and Fire TV—and could help me share one TV input between them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick and Echo Show 8 repeat needs recently covered by my Fire TV Stick 4K Max and Echo Show 5 with its stand.",
    "The enterprise hard drive and internal NVMe SSD assume I want to install computer components, while my storage history makes an external drive a more natural choice.",
    "The headphones, five short USB-C cables, and separate microphone do not address a current need; my webcam already includes a microphone."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Alexa devices seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more speakers, displays, and streaming devices even when their functions are already covered.",
    "My history with storage and computer accessories seems to have been stretched to include internal upgrades and extra peripherals without a clear purpose for me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have just filled; a useful addition should do something beyond those devices.",
    "Compatibility and setup effort matter: portable external storage fits how I have used drives, whereas internal storage requires checks and installation I am not planning.",
    "Accessories feel relevant when they solve a specific problem involving equipment I own, such as switching between my Blu-ray player and Fire TV."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical electronics and Alexa, but missed the difference between useful additions, recently filled needs, and upgrades I am not planning."
}
